# next smaller size mapping for the relative_size scale
size_order = ['extra-small','small','medium','large','extra-large']
cur_size = product.get('relative_size')
cur_idx = size_order.index(cur_size)
next_smaller_size = size_order[cur_idx-1] if cur_idx > 0 else None
print('next_smaller_size', next_smaller_size)

red_small_ids = [v['product_id'] for v in variations if v.get('relative_size')==next_smaller_size and v.get('color')=='red']
grey_small_ids = [v['product_id'] for v in variations if v.get('relative_size')==next_smaller_size and v.get('color')=='grey']
